pages.text: Pour a molten fluid onto a $(l)casting table$() to cast tool parts and small items. Place a cast on the table first to shape the result; without a cast, the fluid sets into an ingot.
A $(l)casting basin$() works the same way for blocks and larger items.$(br2)Each casting recipe has a $(l)cooling time$() — the fluid must finish cooling before the result can be removed.
